client_direction: Rebuild a financially sustainable path toward accessible remote coordination or documentation work while protecting recovery and daily stability.

lanes.current_purpose: Protect recovery while clarifying tolerable bounded activity.
can_proceed_now: Continue small paced observations within existing guidance.
remains_premature: Medical clearance or a durable work-capacity conclusion.
lanes.review_trigger: After another bounded observation or new provider guidance.

lanes.current_purpose: Identify which access supports reduce strain and what remains untested.
can_proceed_now: Document observed effects and prepare an evaluation question.
remains_premature: Treating one trial as proof, prescription, entitlement, or long-term effectiveness.
lanes.review_trigger: After a repeated or take-home trial reviewed by the proper authority.

lanes.current_purpose: Keep activity, recovery, and daily stability visible together.
can_proceed_now: Record same-day, delayed, and consecutive-day effects.
remains_premature: Converting separate observations into a sustainable schedule.
lanes.review_trigger: After comparable observations include consecutive-day recovery.

lanes.current_purpose: Route resource questions to the authority that can make the decision.
can_proceed_now: Prepare bounded equipment, service, or benefits questions.
remains_premature: Eligibility, benefits continuity, service, equipment, or funding promises.
lanes.review_trigger: After a written decision from the relevant program authority.

lanes.current_purpose: Explore low-load skill development without assuming employment readiness.
can_proceed_now: Define one paced training task and review its recovery cost.
remains_premature: A course load, weekly schedule, or employment timetable.
lanes.review_trigger: After one bounded training observation and recovery review.

lanes.current_purpose: Prepare questions for the proper vocational authority.
can_proceed_now: Clarify eligibility, evaluation, planning, and documentation steps.
remains_premature: A service, vendor, training, equipment, funding, or employment decision.
lanes.review_trigger: After the fictional vocational authority issues a written decision.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: Observed computer activity needs repeatability and recovery context.
bridges.desired_outcome: A bounded observation record that does not imply a work schedule.
bridges.proper_authority: Maya Chen (fictional) for self-report; provider for medical guidance
bridges.next_bounded_action: Record one comparable paced activity with same-day and next-day effects.
bridges.dependency: No weekly-capacity claim until adequate evidence and proper review exist.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: Assistive technology may reduce strain under specific conditions.
bridges.desired_outcome: A properly reviewed evaluation or trial question.
bridges.proper_authority: Occupational-therapy authority for functional evaluation; vocational authority for any service or funding decision
bridges.next_bounded_action: Ask what evaluation, trial, or documentation is required.
bridges.dependency: Observation does not equal prescription, approval, entitlement, or funding.
bridges.owner: Maya Chen (fictional) for preparation; external authorities for their decisions
bridges.review_trigger: Receipt of a written evaluation or agency decision.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: A stale vocational plan requires current client confirmation.
bridges.desired_outcome: A current direction that stays separate from capacity conclusions.
bridges.proper_authority: Client for goal direction; vocational authority for agency planning decisions
bridges.next_bounded_action: Confirm, revise, or retire the old plan before presenting it as current.
bridges.dependency: Stale evidence cannot establish present readiness.
bridges.review_trigger: Client review of the synthetic pathway packet.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: Training or assistive-technology services may be considered.
bridges.next_bounded_action: Ask which eligibility and planning steps precede any service decision.
bridges.review_trigger: Receipt of a written eligibility or planning decision.

bridges.need_or_opportunity: Possible earned income creates an individualized benefits-information question.
bridges.desired_outcome: Accurate case-specific reporting guidance from the proper program authority.
bridges.next_bounded_action: Prepare the question and request program-specific guidance.
bridges.dependency: Generic information cannot guarantee benefits continuity.
bridges.owner: Maya Chen (fictional) for the question; program authority for the decision
bridges.review_trigger: Receipt of individualized written program guidance.

minimum_necessary_sharing: Share only the current client direction, relevant source-attributed observations, bounded questions, and authority limits needed for the synthetic review.
next_authorized_step: Human review of the synthetic packet before any further test or use.
still_unauthorized: Eligibility, benefits, service, equipment, or funding claims
